# Leidenschaft für Technologie

Dafür steht die Motorenfabrik Hatz seit knapp 150 Jahren.
Was als kleiner Reparaturbetrieb begonnen hat, ist heute ein weltweit agierendes Unternehmen. Ein
Weg, auf den wir stolz sind. Hatz Dieselmotoren für Baumaschinen begründen unsere Erfolgsgeschichte.
Mit einem zukunftsfähigen Portfolio schreiben wir sie weiter. In Hatz-Lösungen steckt der Anspruch,
das Leben leichter zu machen. Unsere Produkte stehen für Zuverlässigkeit, Effizienz und
Langlebigkeit, mit robusten Technologien, die auch anspruchsvollen Bedingungen standhalten. Als
unabhängiges, mittelständisches Unternehmen verbinden wir Beständigkeit mit kontinuierlicher
Innovationskraft und begleiten unsere Kunden als langfristiger Partner auf ihrem Weg nach vorne. Die
Zukunft bringt Herausforderungen, und Hatz ist bereit, sie mitzugestalten – als Antrieb für
positiven Fortschritt.

**CREATING POWER SOLUTIONS.**

kommen in allen Anwendungsbereichen zum Einsatz, beispielsweise in Baumaschinen, Kompressoren,
Nutzfahrzeugen, Landmaschinen, Aggregaten, Flur- und Förderfahrzeugen sowie in Schiffen. Hatz
entwickelt und fertigt Dieselmotoren in einem Leistungsspektrum von 1,5 bis 64 kW.

# Leidenschaft für Technologie

Dafür steht die Motorenfabrik Hatz seit knapp 150 Jahren.
Was als kleiner Reparaturbetrieb begonnen hat, ist heute ein weltweit agierendes Unternehmen. Ein
Weg, auf den wir stolz sind. Hatz Dieselmotoren für Baumaschinen begründen unsere Erfolgsgeschichte.
Mit einem zukunftsfähigen Portfolio schreiben wir sie weiter. In Hatz-Lösungen steckt der Anspruch,
das Leben leichter zu machen. Unsere Produkte stehen für Zuverlässigkeit, Effizienz und
Langlebigkeit, mit robusten Technologien, die auch anspruchsvollen Bedingungen standhalten. Als
unabhängiges, mittelständisches Unternehmen verbinden wir Beständigkeit mit kontinuierlicher
Innovationskraft und begleiten unsere Kunden als langfristiger Partner auf ihrem Weg nach vorne. Die
Zukunft bringt Herausforderungen, und Hatz ist bereit, sie mitzugestalten – als Antrieb für
positiven Fortschritt.

**CREATING POWER SOLUTIONS.**

### Hatz - Spezialist für Industriemotoren

Hatz ist ein weltweit tätiger unabhängiger Spezialist für 1- bis 4-Zylinder. Unsere Dieselmotoren
kommen in allen Anwendungsbereichen zum Einsatz, beispielsweise in Baumaschinen, Kompressoren,
Nutzfahrzeugen, Landmaschinen, Aggregaten, Flur- und Förderfahrzeugen sowie in Schiffen. Hatz
entwickelt und fertigt Dieselmotoren in einem Leistungsspektrum von 1,5 bis 64 kW.

##### PRODUCTS AND INNOVATION THAT

### PUT YOU IN CONTROL

Our power transmission products and systems are precision manufactured, field tested, and time
proven to provide you with optimal performance, reliability and cost effectiveness.

##### GO ELECTRIC WITH OUR

### ELECTRIC AND HYBRID SYSTEMS

As leaders in power transmission technology, Twin Disc gives you the flexibility to drive everything
from wheels to propellers with internal combustion engine, full electric, or a hybrid system that
takes advantage of both. With electric and hybrid propulsion systems you gain better ways to meet
emissions standards, save on fuel and maintenance costs, and increase efficiency.

FULL ELECTRIC

Eliminate the main diesel engine and its maintenance costs, and cut fuel costs and emissions.
Configurable power-dense energy storage systems efficiently provide the energy needed to power the
application.

SERIAL HYBRID

An electric motor to replace the traditional main diesel engine, drawing electric power from an
onboard energy storage system, onboard gensets, or both.

PARALLEL HYBRID

Pair the diesel engine with an electric motor. This configuration takes advantage of both, allowing
for diesel-only, electric-only, peak shaving, and power boost operation

Kobelt is a Canadian-based manufacturing company with over 60 years of expertise in designing and
producing high-quality products for the marine and industrial sectors. Renowned for its history of
innovation, Kobelt specializes in propulsion, steering, thrusters, and braking control systems.

reliability you expect from Twin Disc. A Parallel Hybrid System takes advantage of both a diesel
engine and an electric motor, allowing for diesel-only, electric-only, peak shaving, and power boost
operation. Explore the system then contact our team of experts to learn about the endless custom
solutions available for your application.

### ELECTRIC AND HYBRID SYSTEMS

As leaders in power transmission technology, Twin Disc gives you the flexibility to drive everything
from wheels to propellers with internal combustion engine, full electric, or a hybrid system that
takes advantage of both. With electric and hybrid propulsion systems you gain better ways to meet
emissions standards, save on fuel and maintenance costs, and increase efficiency.

FULL ELECTRIC

Eliminate the main diesel engine and its maintenance costs, and cut fuel costs and emissions.
Configurable power-dense energy storage systems efficiently provide the energy needed to power the
application.

SERIAL HYBRID

An electric motor to replace the traditional main diesel engine, drawing electric power from an
onboard energy storage system, onboard gensets, or both.

PARALLEL HYBRID

Pair the diesel engine with an electric motor. This configuration takes advantage of both, allowing
for diesel-only, electric-only, peak shaving, and power boost operation

## Welcome to ZF

ZF is a global technology company supplying advanced mobility products and systems for passenger
cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. Its comprehensive product range is primarily
aimed at vehicle manufacturers, mobility providers and start-up companies in the fields of
transportation and mobility. ZF electrifies a wide range of vehicle types. With its products, the
company contributes to reducing emissions, protecting the climate as well as enhancing safe
mobility.

** Click on (+) to learn more about our products and technologies**

today’s potential into tomorrow’s competitive advantages.

## Products

offers comprehensive product and software solutions for established vehicle manufacturers and newly
emerging transport and mobility service providers.

[
Our product portfolio
][4]
Hotspot 3 Aftermarket

## Aftermarket

As one of the leading companies in the aftermarket industry, ZF bridges the gap between today's and
tomorrow's needs by delivering what workshops, distributors, and fleets require across the board.

[
Our aftermarket product portfolio
][5]

Alongside the automotive sector – passenger cars and commercial vehicles – ZF also serves market
segments such as construction and agricultural machinery, wind power, marine propulsion, rail drives
and test systems.

With some 153,000 employees worldwide, ZF reported sales of €38.8 billion in fiscal year 2025. The
company operates 162 production locations in 29 countries.

* # Hangzhou Cagon Transmission Technology Co., Ltd.

  highly recognized **[ship power system][103]** integrator, top manufacturer and professional
  service provider in the industry. In the marine sector, it is a well-deserved leader in
  **[external fire protection][104]** and anti-corrosion engineering. Since its inception, the
  company has been committed to the passion and determination to deepen its presence in the
  shipbuilding industry, anchored on the goal of "one-stop service", and made every effort to create
  a power system overall solution that meets the diverse needs of users. At the same time, it
  focuses on the cutting-edge needs of **[marine equipment][105]**, ingeniously develops new
  anti-corrosion coatings, and uses superb engineering construction skills to protect the quality of
  marine equipment in all aspects.

subsidiary of China State Shipbuilding Corporation Limited (CSSC) and specialized in high-and-low
speed heavy-duty gearboxes.

Chongqing GW marine gearboxes have introduced the professional technology of German LOHMANN &
STOLTERFOHT gearboxes. Marine gearbox can transmit power, reduce speed and bear propeller thrust in
the main power system of the ship. According to different customer requirements, Chongqing gearbox

## 3D SCANNING TECHNOLOGY

### DBS Transform from David Brown Santasalo.

**DBS Transform** converts third-party gearboxes into high-performance DBS gearboxes through the
utilisation of advanced 3D scanning technology to replace the rotating components. This service
ensures minimal downtime during the reverse engineering process and can be executed at any location,
effectively eliminating all potential obstacles for the customer.

[Unlock the full potential of your gearbox.][77]

## SERVICING

### Global expertise with local service engineers near you.

We can service, maintain, repair, and upgrade any industrial gearbox make or model. We have service
centres positioned right across the globe, which means we are close to you 24/7/365 days a year. We
offer so much more than aftermarket support, we are here to support you every step of the way. Talk
to us about how we can help transform your operations as your solutions partner of choice. 

[Ready to book your next repair or maintenance?][78]

### Always watching to safeguard your gear system.

Gearwatch condition monitoring from David Brown Santasalo monitors the health of your gearbox in
real time and alerts you to any deviations from the specified condition as soon as they occur. These
deviations can be analysed and evaluated to ensure maximised system availability, and with access to
your own, bespoke portal, you are in control 24/7!

## 3D SCANNING TECHNOLOGY

### DBS Transform from David Brown Santasalo.

**DBS Transform** converts third-party gearboxes into high-performance DBS gearboxes through the
utilisation of advanced 3D scanning technology to replace the rotating components. This service
ensures minimal downtime during the reverse engineering process and can be executed at any location,
effectively eliminating all potential obstacles for the customer.

[Unlock the full potential of your gearbox.][77]

## SERVICING

### Global expertise with local service engineers near you.

We can service, maintain, repair, and upgrade any industrial gearbox make or model. We have service
centres positioned right across the globe, which means we are close to you 24/7/365 days a year. We
offer so much more than aftermarket support, we are here to support you every step of the way. Talk
to us about how we can help transform your operations as your solutions partner of choice. 

[Ready to book your next repair or maintenance?][78]

## REMOTE MONITORING

### Always watching to safeguard your gear system.

Gearwatch condition monitoring from David Brown Santasalo monitors the health of your gearbox in
real time and alerts you to any deviations from the specified condition as soon as they occur. These
deviations can be analysed and evaluated to ensure maximised system availability, and with access to
your own, bespoke portal, you are in control 24/7!

[Enhance the longevity of your gear system][79]

## HERITAGE

### Celebrating 165 years of David Brown Santasalo

David Brown Santasalo is proud to mark 165 years of world-class engineering, manufacturing and
service, tracing our roots back to 1860 when David Brown in the UK commenced cast gear
manufacturing!  In 2016, David Brown joined forces with Santasalo to become one of the world’s
leading mechanical power transmission brands: David Brown Santasalo. Today we are a global operation
with locations spanning six continents.

coolers, gauges or a rebuild kit, Diesel Pro has you covered for your Detroit Diesel Marine Engine

Cummins Diesel Marine Engines. If you buy with us, you can take the guesswork out of the process. We

looking for, give us a call so we can help!

transmission is an important link between your motor and propeller, so replacing parts when needed
is very important. If you locate the name of the nameplate, you can get the model number. Then, you

### Welcome

Following extensive consultation with industry stakeholders, we have decided to pause Electric &
Hybrid Marine North America for 2026. This decision reflects the current pace of policy development
and investment in the U.S. market, and our commitment to delivering events that provide maximum
value for exhibitors and attendees.

In the meantime, we invite you to explore Electric & Hybrid Marine Expo, taking place June
16–18, 2026 in Amsterdam. This global event attracts leading international innovators, world-class
speakers, and key decision-makers from across the marine industry. Discover how you can continue to
cement key strategic partnerships at our global event in Amsterdam and explore your chance to
connect with decision-makers, discover the latest technologies, and ensure your future within this
future-forward industry.

 

[Discover the opportunities in Amsterdam][27]

[Electric & Hybrid Marine exhibitor and visitor]

### Experience the innovations

Join the dynamic pursuit of innovative, scalable, and commercially viable solutions for electrifying
and hybridizing marine vessels. This competitive yet collaborative journey brings together
world-class innovators, engineers, and industry experts. Be part of these transformative
advancements! 

**[WHY ATTEND][28]**

][29]

### Present the business case 

Join a global platform of experts dedicated to forging partnerships for a progressive and more
efficient maritime sector. Showcase the commercial benefits to highlight the crucial return on
investment, ensuring your advancement with ideal business partners.

## ABOUT US

We are an award-winning developer of interactive entertainment based near Dallas, Texas. Founded in
February 1999 by game industry veterans and led to this day by its founding developers, Gearbox
Entertainment has distinguished itself as one of the most respected and recognized video game makers
in the world.

## Marine Pump Supplier, Marine Automation, Marine Hydraulics & Marine Gearbox Specialists

**With 30+ Years of Marine Industry Experience, Green Alfa Machinery** is a trusted **Marine Pump
Supplier** and global exporter based near **Alang Ship Recycling Yard, Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India**.
We specialize in supplying high-quality **[Marine Pumps][93], [Marine Pump Spare Parts][94], Marine
Automation Systems, Marine Hydraulics Spare Parts, and Marine Gearboxes** for commercial ships,
offshore platforms, tankers, cargo vessels, tugboats, and power plant applications worldwide.

Our comprehensive product range includes **Marine Fuel Pumps, Marine Bilge Pumps, Marine Ballast
Pumps, Marine Cargo Pumps, Marine Cooling Water Pumps, Centrifugal Pumps, Gear Pumps, Screw Pumps,
Hydraulic Pumps, Lube Oil Pumps, Fresh Water Pumps, Sea Water Pumps, Fire Pumps**, along with
genuine **impellers, mechanical seals, shafts, bearings, repair kits, seal kits, gaskets, couplings,
and other Marine Pump Spare Parts** for reliable vessel operation.

We are also a reliable supplier of **[Marine Automation Systems][95]**, including **Dynamic
Positioning (DP) Systems, Marine Fire Detection & Alarm Systems, Bilge Alarm Monitors, Control
Panels, Sensors, PLC Systems, Engine Room Automation, and Automation Spare Parts**, helping ship
owners improve operational safety and efficiency.

As a trusted marine equipment supplier, we provide genuine and OEM replacement parts for leading
brands, including **Taiko Kikai Pumps, Shinko Pump Spare Parts, Allweiler Screw Pumps, SPX FLOW
Marine Pumps, Cat Pumps, IMO Pumps, Desmi Pumps, Framo Pumps, Azcue Pumps, KSB Pumps, Ebara Pumps,
and Grundfos Marine Pumps**. Every product is quality-tested, available in new, reconditioned, or
reusable condition, and supported by fast worldwide delivery and technical assistance.

#### ****Global expertise in industrial and marine gearboxes****

# **Industrial Gearbox Overhaul, Inspection & Lifetime Management – Worldwid**e

learn more

##### What We Do

## 20+ Years of **Worldwide Industrial Gearbox Services**

We specialize in inspection, overhaul, and long-term reliability solutions for industrial and marine
gearboxes operating under extreme loads and continuous production conditions.

Our services are designed to reduce downtime, extend gearbox lifetime, and improve operational
safety.

[LEARN MORE][16]

##### Core Services

## We deliver reliable industrial gearbox services designed to reduce downtime and extend equipment
## lifetime worldwide.

#### Industrial Gearbox Overhaul (On-Site)

We perform industrial gearbox overhauls directly on-site, minimizing production downtime and
eliminating transport-related risks.

#### Industrial Gearbox Inspection

Our industrial gearbox inspections provide detailed condition assessments, identifying wear, damage,
and remaining service life.

#### Mobile Machining

We provide precision mobile machining services directly on-site, allowing critical components to be
repaired or machined without dismantling or transport.

#### Gearbox & Driveline Lifetime Management

We support customers with long-term gearbox and driveline lifetime management programs, including
condition monitoring strategies, maintenance planning, and technical recommendations.

## Industries We Serve

#### [Cement Industry][17]

We specialize in cement industry gearboxes, including ball mill gearboxes and SAG mill gearboxes,
supporting reliable operation during high-load and high-temperature.

#### [Girth Rings for Kilns and Mills][18]

We provide inspection and technical support for girth rings used in kilns and mills, supporting
alignment control, wear evaluation, and operational reliability.

#### [Mining Industry][19]

Industrial gearbox inspection and overhaul services for SAG mill and ball mill gearboxes in mining
operations worldwide.


#### [Marine Industry][20]

We offer inspection and overhaul services for marine gearboxes, supporting propulsion and auxiliary
systems worldwide.


## Worldwide Gearbox Service

With mobile service and global project experience, Hedberg Technical Services delivers industrial
gearbox services worldwide.

[Get in touch][21]

**FAQ**

**What does Hedberg Technical Services do?**

Hedberg Technical Services specializes in on-site industrial gearbox overhaul, inspection, and
lifetime management. We mobilize directly to your plant, mine, or vessel anywhere in the world —
performing complete gearbox overhauls where the equipment stands, without the delays and risks of
shipping to a workshop.

**What industries do you serve?**

We serve heavy industries where gearbox reliability is critical — primarily cement production,
mining and mineral processing, and marine operations. We have completed assignments across Europe,
Africa, and beyond.

**Can you really perform a full gearbox overhaul on-site?**

Yes. We bring all necessary precision tooling, measuring equipment, and technical expertise directly
to your location. A full on-site overhaul — disassembly, inspection, component replacement,
reassembly, alignment verification, and commissioning — is our core service.

**How quickly can you mobilize?**

We respond as fast as possible for both planned assignments and emergency breakdowns. Contact us
directly with your location and situation and we will give you a realistic mobilization timeline
immediately.

**What gearbox types and brands do you work with?**

We work with all major industrial gearbox types — helical, bevel, planetary, worm, and combined
designs — from manufacturers including Flender, Renk, Hansen, David Brown, SEW, Brevini, Reintjes,
ZF, and others.

**Why choose on-site overhaul over sending the gearbox to a workshop?**

hipping a large industrial gearbox to a workshop typically means 4–12 weeks of downtime, complex
logistics, and transport risk. On-site overhaul eliminates all of that — your gearbox is repaired
where it stands, and your plant or vessel returns to operation significantly faster.

**Do you offer emergency breakdown support?**

Yes. We prioritize emergency calls and mobilize as fast as logistics allow. Contact us immediately
when a breakdown occurs — do not wait.

## KARL SENNER's History

**Karl Senner, LLC** is the premier distributor, systems integrator, and service provider of
high-performance marine propulsion equipment and electrical systems. As the exclusive sales and
service representative for **REINTJES Marine Gearboxes** across North America, we also supply and
support a full range of propulsion solutions—including azimuth propulsors, controllable pitch
propellers, tunnel thrusters, advanced control systems, and integrated electrical packages.

Backed by decades of experience, we pair premium products with industry-leading service to help
customers maximize vessel uptime, safety, and performance. Our long-standing reputation is built on
delivering reliable solutions and responsive support throughout the full lifecycle of every vessel.

At Karl Senner, “Propelling Excellence” is more than a tagline—it’s a promise. It reflects our
dedication to continuous improvement, operational reliability, and long-term partnerships. From
equipment selection to lifetime support, we are committed to moving our customers forward with
unmatched propulsion expertise.

## Welcome to ME Production

At ME Production, we deliver sustainable, high-performance solutions to the maritime industry –
built on more than 50 years of Danish engineering expertise. From SOx scrubber systems and hybrid
gear to waste heat recovery via heat pumps, we help you reduce emissions, boost energy efficiency,
and improve long-term profitability.

We manage complete projects from idea to installation, including design, production, commissioning,
and service – always tailored to your vessel’s needs. With global reach and local service hubs,
we’re ready to support you wherever you operate.

Choose ME Production – and move your operations toward a cleaner, smarter future.

### Innovative engineering

We also help customers develop, produce, and engineer technology in either their own or our designs.

Do you have plans to reduce your emissions and create cleaner air? 

ME Productions’ Innovation Team is ready to assist, bringing our capabilities into play to help you
meet your environmental goals and targets through the development of new technologies.

### Efficient service solutions

Our service is here to help you ensure that your vessel is not only environmentally responsible but
also efficient and profitable. Secure your vessel's profitability and the planet's well being.

Contact us today to discover how our service can transform your marine operations. Let's work
together to create a cleaner, greener, and more profitable voyage.

# About Masson Marine

Propulsion maker Since 1908

Masson Marine, as a leader in Marine Propulsion Technology, designs, manufactures and commissions a
full range of marine gearboxes with hybrid systems, brakes whether integrated or external, shaft
lines and controllable or fixed pitched propellers.

Our engineering team skilled with both marine and mechanical engineers achieves the best products
designed for your specific needs. We are internationally renowned for over 110 years for the
reliability and durability of our products.
* Woldwide Service Network (>30 dealers).
* Easy Maintenance (no specific tool required).
* Large stock of spare parts.
* Masson Marine is committed to his customers and will do everything to fulfill its engagements.

# **Welcome**

**With a precision engineering pedigree, PRM Newage Ltd has established an enviable reputation as a
specialist in the design and manufacture of high efficiency mechanical driveline equipment.**

**From its roots at the birth of the UK automotive industry, the company has evolved a product range
that encompasses a wide variety of driveline solutions like the NEWAGE brand of airport belt loader
and baggage tractor drive and steer axles, as well as the world renowned PRM marine gearbox
range. **

**We are now the worlds leading Ground Support Equipment vehicle drive and steer axle manufacturer
with over 30,000 axles in the field.**

# Von Hameln aus die Welt antreiben: REINTJES entwickelt und fertigt maßgeschneiderte Getriebe für
# alle Schiffstypen

Kleine und große Schiffsgetriebe aus Hameln. Vor allem für Yachten, Fähren und Arbeitsschiffe. Das
ist die Kernkompetenz der REINTJES GmbH.

Wir haben aber noch viel mehr zu bieten als [maritime Antriebstechnik.][16] Eine unserer ganz großen
Stärken? Wir sind Problemlöser und Konzeptentwickler für Reedereien, Yachtbesitzerinnen und
Yachtbesitzer, Fährgesellschaften und Staaten auf der ganzen Welt.

Und da wir immer nah an unseren Kundinnen und Kunden sein möchten, um gemeinsam die Zukunft der
maritimen Industrie mitzugestalten, verfügen wir über [elf Tochtergesellschaften und zahlreiche
Servicepartner rund um den Globus.][17]

Weltweit arbeiten über 500 Menschen für uns. Und nach und nach sollen es noch mehr werden. REINTJES
möchte weiterwachsen und sich stetig weiterentwickeln – und dafür benötigen wir tatkräftige
Unterstützung.

Was wir unseren (neuen) Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern genau bieten, haben wir in unserem
Karrierebereich zusammengestellt. Dort finden Sie auch offene Stellen und können sich direkt
bewerben. [Klicken Sie sich einfach mal rein.][18]

## Modern mit viel Erfahrung

Was uns neben [Produkten made in Germany][19] mit ganz viel Zukunftscharakter und einer großen
Portion Internationalität noch auszeichnet? Ein ausgewogener Mix aus Tradition und Moderne.

[REINTJES gibt es bereits seit 1879.][20] In diesem langen Zeitraum haben wir viel Know-how rund um
Schiffsgetriebe aufgebaut. Dieses Fachwissen verfeinern wir jeden Tag und lassen es in unser Angebot
einfließen.

Zudem sind wir modern und kombinieren soziale Merkmale als verantwortungsbewusster Arbeitgeber mit
nachhaltigen Akzenten.

Als [Unternehmen in Stiftungshand][21] stehen wir für Sicherheit und engagieren uns auf
unterschiedlichen Ebenen an unserem Firmensitz in Hameln und für unser Team.

Betriebs-Kita und ein umfangreiches Gesundheitsmanagement sind da nur zwei Beispiele. Dazu kommt:
Wir arbeiten nicht nur gerne zusammen, sondern stärken unseren Zusammenhalt auch abseits von Büro
oder Werkbank bei regelmäßigen Events und Veranstaltungen wie Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und
Drachenbootrennen auf der Weser.

Und dass Nachhaltigkeit bei uns nicht nur eine abgedroschene Phrase ist, unterstreichen wir mit
einer Ergänzung unserer Produktpalette um hybride und vollelektrische Schiffsgetriebe,
Unternehmens-CO2-Fußabdruck, Fotovoltaikanlage und vielem mehr.

Wenn Sie noch mehr über uns und unseren Teamspirit erfahren möchten oder ins Team [#REINTYES][22]
kommen möchten, melden Sie sich gerne bei uns.

# News

## REINTJES wartet Schiffsgetriebe von Alex II

Eine Bark mit echtem Wiedererkennungswert: Genau das trifft auf die Alexander von Humboldt II zu.
Jung und Alt kennen den grünen Dreimaster, der als Segelschulschiff von der Deutschen Stiftung Sail
Training (DSST) betrieben wird.

Damit das dauerhaft so bleibt, ist die DSST auf Unterstützung und Spenden angewiesen. Auch REINTJES
hat sich hier beteiligt – und zwar in Form einer kostenfreien Getriebewartung.

[>> mehr][23]
[[Folie für die 3-Fragen-3-Antworten-Serie mit Entwicklungsingenieurin Daniela Haubold.]][24]

## 3 Fragen – 3 Antworten mit: Daniela Haubold

3 Fragen – 3 Antworten. Mit diesem Format stellen wir unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter vor.

Wissen möchten wir, wie genau die jeweiligen Aufgaben bei REINTJES aussehen und welche
Herausforderungen mit dem Job verbunden sind.

Und natürlich ist ebenfalls spannend, was das Unternehmen REINTJES auszeichnet.

# Von Hameln aus die Welt antreiben: REINTJES entwickelt und fertigt maßgeschneiderte Getriebe für
# alle Schiffstypen

Kleine und große Schiffsgetriebe aus Hameln. Vor allem für Yachten, Fähren und Arbeitsschiffe. Das
ist die Kernkompetenz der REINTJES GmbH.

Wir haben aber noch viel mehr zu bieten als [maritime Antriebstechnik.][16] Eine unserer ganz großen
Stärken? Wir sind Problemlöser und Konzeptentwickler für Reedereien, Yachtbesitzerinnen und
Yachtbesitzer, Fährgesellschaften und Staaten auf der ganzen Welt.

Und da wir immer nah an unseren Kundinnen und Kunden sein möchten, um gemeinsam die Zukunft der
maritimen Industrie mitzugestalten, verfügen wir über [elf Tochtergesellschaften und zahlreiche
Servicepartner rund um den Globus.][17]

Weltweit arbeiten über 500 Menschen für uns. Und nach und nach sollen es noch mehr werden. REINTJES
möchte weiterwachsen und sich stetig weiterentwickeln – und dafür benötigen wir tatkräftige
Unterstützung.

Was wir unseren (neuen) Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern genau bieten, haben wir in unserem
Karrierebereich zusammengestellt. Dort finden Sie auch offene Stellen und können sich direkt
bewerben. [Klicken Sie sich einfach mal rein.][18]

## Modern mit viel Erfahrung

Was uns neben [Produkten made in Germany][19] mit ganz viel Zukunftscharakter und einer großen
Portion Internationalität noch auszeichnet? Ein ausgewogener Mix aus Tradition und Moderne.

[REINTJES gibt es bereits seit 1879.][20] In diesem langen Zeitraum haben wir viel Know-how rund um
Schiffsgetriebe aufgebaut. Dieses Fachwissen verfeinern wir jeden Tag und lassen es in unser Angebot
einfließen.

Zudem sind wir modern und kombinieren soziale Merkmale als verantwortungsbewusster Arbeitgeber mit
nachhaltigen Akzenten.

Als [Unternehmen in Stiftungshand][21] stehen wir für Sicherheit und engagieren uns auf
unterschiedlichen Ebenen an unserem Firmensitz in Hameln und für unser Team.

Betriebs-Kita und ein umfangreiches Gesundheitsmanagement sind da nur zwei Beispiele. Dazu kommt:
Wir arbeiten nicht nur gerne zusammen, sondern stärken unseren Zusammenhalt auch abseits von Büro
oder Werkbank bei regelmäßigen Events und Veranstaltungen wie Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und
Drachenbootrennen auf der Weser.

Und dass Nachhaltigkeit bei uns nicht nur eine abgedroschene Phrase ist, unterstreichen wir mit
einer Ergänzung unserer Produktpalette um hybride und vollelektrische Schiffsgetriebe,
Unternehmens-CO2-Fußabdruck, Fotovoltaikanlage und vielem mehr.

Wenn Sie noch mehr über uns und unseren Teamspirit erfahren möchten oder ins Team [#REINTYES][22]
kommen möchten, melden Sie sich gerne bei uns.

SPW, Hyundai SeasAll, Cox y ePropulsion. Estas últimas también para el Norte de África (Cox) y
Portugal (Hyundai SeasAll, ePropulsion). Solé Iberia ofrece una amplia gama de soluciones para el
sector marino, tanto de recreo como profesional.

##                              **

TSD surface drive systems are engineered on the fundamental principle of surface-piercing propulsion

providing a propulsion solution across the full spectrum of modern fast vessel powertrain
configurations.
Every TSD surface drive system is manufactured under ISO 9001:2015/2016 quality management
certification and carries ABS (American Bureau of Shipping) and CCS (China Classification Society)
classification society approval — the two certification standards most commonly specified in naval,
coast guard, and commercial vessel procurement contracts worldwide. Propeller blades and shafts are
manufactured from duplex stainless steel (2205 grade, PREN ≥35) for verified resistance to
corrosion, fatigue, and erosion in the most demanding marine environments.

fleets, sport fishing operators, and naval procurement programmes — have selected TSD surface drives
for missions where propulsion failure is not an acceptable outcome. TSD's engineering team provides
vessel-specific technical consultation, 2D installation drawings, and full lifecycle technical
support from initial specification through to in-service maintenance.

The TSD product range covers engine inputs from 60HP to 1,500HP across thirteen standard models in
two installation families — the BG series for deep-V hulls at 45-degree transom geometry, and the BH
series for flat-bottom and semi-V hulls at 10–13 degrees. Both series are fully compatible with
inboard diesel engines, gasoline engines, hybrid electric drives, and gas turbine powerplants,
providing a propulsion solution across the full spectrum of modern fast vessel powertrain
configurations.
Every TSD surface drive system is manufactured under ISO 9001:2015/2016 quality management
certification and carries ABS (American Bureau of Shipping) and CCS (China Classification Society)
classification society approval — the two certification standards most commonly specified in naval,
coast guard, and commercial vessel procurement contracts worldwide. Propeller blades and shafts are
manufactured from duplex stainless steel (2205 grade, PREN ≥35) for verified resistance to
corrosion, fatigue, and erosion in the most demanding marine environments.
 
Operators across more than 30 countries — including coast guard agencies, customs enforcement
fleets, sport fishing operators, and naval procurement programmes — have selected TSD surface drives
for missions where propulsion failure is not an acceptable outcome. TSD's engineering team provides
vessel-specific technical consultation, 2D installation drawings, and full lifecycle technical
support from initial specification through to in-service maintenance.

* [ [Speed Yacht] ][74]
  Speed Yacht
  
  TSD surface drive systems are the propulsion of choice for high-performance speed yachts demanding
  sustained speeds above 40 knots. The surface-piercing propeller eliminates submerged appendage
  drag, allowing sleek deep-V yacht hulls to reach their full design speed potential with
  significantly lower fuel burn than conventional inboard drives. Twin BG660 or BG750 installations
  are the most common configuration on 10–18 metre performance yachts.
* [ [High Speed Sports Rowing] ][75]
  High Speed Sports Rowing
  For competitive sport and racing applications where every knot is decisive, TSD surface drives
  deliver the rapid acceleration and sustained top-end thrust that racing crews demand. The
  instantaneous thrust response of the surface-piercing propeller during throttle transitions gives
  TSD-equipped racing vessels a measurable hole-shot advantage over conventionally propelled
  competitors. Compatible with gasoline, diesel, and hybrid high-performance engines.
